WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT
        d_date_sk,
        d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT
        i_item_sk,
        i_brand_id,
        i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
),
sales_by_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        sum(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT fd.d_date_sk
        FROM filtered_dates AS fd
        WHERE fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    )
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT fi.i_item_sk
        FROM filtered_items AS fi
        WHERE fi.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    )
    GROUP BY
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk
)
SELECT
    fd.d_year,
    fi.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    fi.i_brand AS brand,
    sum(sales_by_keys.sum_agg) AS sum_agg
FROM filtered_dates AS fd
JOIN sales_by_keys
    ON fd.d_date_sk = sales_by_keys.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN filtered_items AS fi
    ON sales_by_keys.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
GROUP BY
    fd.d_year,
    fi.i_brand,
    fi.i_brand_id
ORDER BY
    fd.d_year,
    sum(sales_by_keys.sum_agg) DESC,
    fi.i_brand_id
LIMIT 100
